Contract No. 26.0000129384.0583
Contract Name: Fire Systems Maintenance - Northern Tunnels & Coffs Harbour Tunnels
This contract is for the routine, reactive and ordered maintenance of fire systems across the Northern NSW Tunnels (package 1), and the Coffs Harbour Tunnels (package 2). The two separable contract packages are based on geographical locations as below;
Package 1: Northern Tunnels includes:
St Helena Tunnels near Byron Bay constructed as part of the Tintenbar to Ewingsdale Pacific Highway Upgrade Project. Opened to traffic in December 2015.
Tugun Bypass Tunnel in Tweed Heads West under the Gold Coast Airport constructed as part of the Tugun Bypass. Opened to traffic in June 2008.
Cudgen Road Tunnel in Duranbah constructed as part of the Yelgun and Chinderah Pacific Highway Upgrade Project. Opened in 2002.
Package 2 Coffs Harbour Tunnels includes:
Coffs Harbour Bypass tunnels comprising Roberts Hill Tunnel, Shephards Lane Tunnel and Gatelys Road Tunnel. The tunnels are expected to open to traffic in December 2026 as part of the Coffs Harbour Bypass Project.
Each Package can be awarded to one or more Contractors based on outcomes of submission evaluation. Pay items within each package are not separable.
All maintenance activities are to be carried out in accordance with the relevant Australian Standards, including AS 1851-2012, Transport for NSW Code of Maintenance Specifications (COMS), and applicable TfNSW specifications. Minimum Qualification: Vendors need to be registered under the FPAA fire protection accreditation scheme at the date of closing of tenders.
Contract Term is 3 years, with two 1-year ext. options, for maximum term of 5 years.
Two mandatory on-site pre-tender meetings will be held at:
Northern Tunnels: 10:00 am on 27th of August 2026 Meeting at 2 Sussyer Ave Tweed Heads West NSW 2485
Coffs Harbour Tunnels: 1:00pm on 24th August 2026, Meeting at Coffs Harbour Bypass Project Office 182 North Boambee Road North Boambee Valley NSW 2450
Attendance at both on-site pre-tender meetings is mandatory to submit a conforming tender.
Please confirm your attendance at each of the onsite pre-tender meeting and site inspection by COB, Friday 21st August 2026 by sending an email with attendee details to michael.buchanan2 @transport.nsw.gov.au ﻿ with subject line “Pre-Tender On-site Meeting attendance confirmation 26.0000129384.0583.”
All tenderers must comply with the Transport Statement of Business Ethics through the procurement process and any subsequent contract period.
All tenderers must comply with the NSW Government Procurement Policy Framework, NSW Government Supplier Code of Conduct and New South Wales Industrial Relations Guidelines: Building and Construction Procurement.
